summary: Executed all 4 phases of the documentation plan, producing docs/modal-axiom-schema-architecture.md (508 lines, new repo-root docs/ directory). Phase 1: scaffolded the file with title, overview (canonical count phrasing stated once), section outline, and Area 1 (18-tag ModalSchemaTag alphabet, .Holds existential encoding, SchemaUnion combinator, @[simp] elimination API). Phase 2: Area 2 (SchemaUnion.subsumption, the 15 per-system tag sets, the 24 direct edges, and the REQUIRED Cube.lean semantic-vs-syntactic disambiguation with a comparison table) and Area 3 (the five FrameCorrespondence lemmas, FrameValidatesTag, unionSound as the syntax/semantics hinge). Phase 3: Area 4 (HasAxiom* representation-agnostic insulation layer, the extends hierarchy, the verified HasAxiomT instance witness from Instances/S5.lean) and Area 5 (s5Tags vs kb5Tags, the deliberately omitted KB5->S5 edge as a decidable consequence). Phase 4: Area 6 (Representation A vs B rationale) and Area 7 (intuitionistic/minimal families as a future instance, not a fork, with all five family file paths grep-confirmed before citing), plus the final consistency pass. All hard constraints verified at completion: zero task-number citations (grep exit code 1), zero '15 inductives' occurrences, Cube.lean disambiguation present, all cited Lean signatures and file paths re-verified directly against on-disk source during authoring (not merely trusted from the research report).
decisions_made: Re-verified every quoted Lean signature and file path directly against on-disk source during authoring rather than trusting the research report's transcriptions alone, since this is a durable, long-lived deliverable.
